Each digital gauge used to measure pressure in the magnitude of 3 psig (20.9 kPa gauge) and higher shall meet the following requirements in addition to satisfying the minimum requirements set forth in Section 406.4.3:
   1.   The gauge shall have a minimum reading of 1/100 of a psig (69 Pa), and
   2.   An extra charged battery shall be readily available for immediate use with the gauge.
